_note: Sound (SPEC §24, ROADMAP M5). cues: each sound's file ("" = none yet: it plays nothing), its bus, and an optional db offset (-6 is half as loud, -1.9 is 20% quieter). events: the game moments that play cues, each entry a cue id or {"cue", "after" seconds}. The cue list being made is data/audio-asset-list.csv; music comes from tools/midi_draft.py and tools/render_audio.py.

duck._note: Music dips this much while a stinger or voice line plays, for about this long, then comes back.

queue._note: Cues that duck the music (stingers and voice lines) take turns: one starts when the last ends; one that would wait longer than max_wait seconds is dropped. No cue plays over itself. Clicks and fireworks aren't queued.

map_day._note: Phrases from map_ambience's day pool, not one loop.

intro_music._note: The end-of-map victory tune at double tempo, under the title screen.

new_tower._note: "New Tower!", with a thunderclap at the front (clipped on purpose, the user's call)

recruit_joined._note: A recruit attempt succeeds, or a rare recruit joins.

firework._note: One burst: a pop or crackle. Plays with each of the fireworks show's 5 bursts (0.35 s apart), separate from the building's riff.

music._note: Which music plays where. Music cues crossfade over fade_seconds; a cue with a pool plays phrases (map_ambience), and day and night turn into each other instead (the phrase finishes, then the dusk or dawn turn). The title screen plays intro_music; the other menus play the day pool, so it carries on into a map that starts by day. battle: by the battle hex's terrain, anything not listed plays _default.
music.title: intro_music

map_ambience._note: The map's ambience (docs/map-ambience.md, ROADMAP M5 map ambience), played by Sound for the cues with a pool (map_day, map_night). pools: each one's files (<prefix>NN.wav), the turn that leads into it, and its ambience folder; a pool may set its own gap. By day or night, a phrase from that state's pool (phrases folder, <state>_NN.wav, from tools/map_phrases.py and tools/build_map_audio.py) plays, never the same one twice running, then gap seconds of silence (a random length in the range); rest_chance of the time it sits a phrase out. At dusk and dawn the phrase playing finishes, then that turn plays, then the other state's pool. Under it, ambience/<state>/bed.wav loops (crossfading over bed_fade seconds at the turn) and the folder's other files are one-shots, one every shot_gap seconds, at a random volume in shot_db, pitched up or down by up to shot_pitch and panned up to shot_pan. Volumes are dB offsets on the Music bus (phrases) and Effects bus (ambience). tools/preview_map_audio.py plays these settings into one file, to hear them before the game does.

events._note: new_<type>: after the riff, the first time you take that building; retaken: after the riff, when you take back one the enemy took from you. taken_<type>: you take a town, tower or temple (the enemy taking a neutral one plays nothing); building_lost: the enemy takes one of yours; firework_burst: each burst of the fireworks over a liberated building.
